themes.name: Agentic AI in research
themes.description: Focuses on AI agents performing autonomous research tasks, data analysis, and complex problem-solving across various domains.

themes.name: AI research tools
themes.description: Covers a broad spectrum of AI tools designed to assist in the research process, from data collection to analysis and insight generation.

themes.name: AI coding assistants
themes.description: Details the use of AI in assisting developers with writing, debugging, and analyzing code, including security vulnerabilities introduced by AI.

themes.name: AI summarization
themes.description: Explores AI's capability to condense large amounts of text, such as meeting notes, articles, or research papers, into concise summaries.

themes.name: AI usability testing
themes.description: Discusses how AI is being integrated into the testing and validation of AI-powered products and features for user-friendliness.

themes.name: AI workforce impact
themes.description: Analyzes how AI is affecting job roles, hiring practices, reskilling needs, and overall employment trends across industries.

themes.name: AI research platform
themes.description: Focuses on AI platforms specifically built to facilitate and accelerate scientific and academic research processes.

themes.name: AI customer insights
themes.description: Covers the application of AI in analyzing customer data to derive actionable insights for marketing, sales, and product development.

themes.name: Synthetic users
themes.description: Examines the creation and use of simulated users or personas for testing, research, or understanding user behavior.

themes.name: AI tool evaluation
themes.description: Covers the assessment and comparison of various AI tools, often with a focus on specific use cases or industries.

note: Themes identified by analyzing articles from curated sources, Google News, HackerNews, and DEV.to this month.
